span: an unregistered document affecting the immovable property and required by Registration Act to be registered may be received as evidence of a contract in a suit for specific performance
why: Headnote holding that an unregistered agreement to sell can be received as evidence in a specific-performance suit, which supports enforceability of an unregistered agreement; the document is written but unregistered. Headnote confidence is capped.
